text: {"name":"set_desc_chain","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes one descriptor-table slot as a linked chain of fixed-size descriptors for a buffer length clamped to 64 KiB, then stores the chain head in the caller context.","subsystem":"mm","var_renames":{"v3":"slot_offset","v4":"desc_table_base","v5":"desc_default_word","v6":"buffer_word","v7":"desc_head","v8":"remaining_size","v10":"aux_word","v11":"next_desc","v12":"tail_size","v13":"last_desc"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"descriptor word 0: constant/type word"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"descriptor word 1: auxiliary word; cleared for last descriptor"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"descriptor word 2: buffer/context value copied from a1[4]"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"descriptor word 3: next descriptor pointer, or end value in last descriptor"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"descriptor word 4: zeroed status/unused field"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"caller context a1[3]: descriptor chain head"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"caller context a1[4]: source descriptor value"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"caller context a1[5]: auxiliary descriptor value"}]}
